scope: Appearance helper system-library evidence. These shared libraries are provided by the host OS, not copied into the current Jazzkeys package. This is a local measured artifact record, not the final-release or CI runtime library version.

libraries.name: GLib / GIO / GObject
libraries.build_metadata_basis: Exact glib-2.0.pc and gio-2.0.pc from the development sysroot used by the successful local packaging build; records retained below.
libraries.distribution: Dynamically linked host system libraries, not bundled
libraries.source_delivery: Jazzkeys helper source and build recipe are in the project source companion. A source redistribution claim for separate GLib binaries is not made: none are copied by packaging. Reassess if future packaging bundles or statically links GLib.
libraries.replacement_route: Ordinary ELF dynamic-loader selection of ABI-compatible shared libraries; the helper has no RPATH or RUNPATH. Recipients may use their own library installation/loader path, or rebuild the GPL helper/application with pkg-config pointing to their chosen library build. No restriction on library modification or debugging is imposed.

local_helper_measurement.method: Read-only readelf -d, -V, and -l on the existing helper; no binary execution or rebuild
local_helper_measurement.exact_runtime_glib_version: Host-dependent; not established by SONAME or pkg-config metadata
local_helper_measurement.platform_floor_note: This helper references up to GLIBC_2.34. The separate current native addon still sets the stricter known GLIBC_2.39 package floor.
local_helper_measurement.build_receipt: Local clean-source packaging build using the recorded GLib 2.84.4 development sysroot completed successfully on 2026-10-06. The package manifest records the measured helper hash. This does not identify libraries loaded later on another host.

ci_scope.version_status: Do not substitute the local 2.84.4 metadata for this CI host. Exact CI development/runtime package versions are not recorded in this inventory.

macos.build_recipe: appearance/build.ts links the system Foundation framework with -fobjc-arc; Jazzkeys does not copy Apple framework binaries
macos.binary_linkage_status: Not remeasured in this Linux review; no unsupported version claim
